name: local_business_lead_finder
description: Discover, extract, and enrich local business leads from Google Maps. Find businesses by keyword and location, collect contact details, emails, and social profiles, and export clean, deduplicated data. Built for automation, CRMs, and recurring lead generation workflows.
capabilities: Local Business Lead Finder (Google Maps Leads Scraper)
Build prospect lists of local businesses for sales outreach and agency prospecting (e.g., plumbers, restaurants, clinics).
Local SEO research: analyze competitors, business density, and presence by area.
Market research: track businesses by geography and status over time.
Scheduled lead refresh: run recurring discovery and only surface new or updated business leads.

inputs.name: queries
inputs.description: List of business types to find (e.g. ['dentist', 'pizza']).

inputs.name: locations
inputs.description: List of locations to search in (e.g. ['Berlin', 'Hamburg']).

inputs.name: geo
inputs.description: Search by coordinates and radius instead of text location.

inputs.name: maxResultsTotal
inputs.description: Maximum number of unique leads to output for the whole run.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Language for Google Maps interface.

inputs.name: includeClosed
inputs.description: If true, includes businesses marked as permanently closed.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Fast mode extracts leads only. Deep mode enables website enrichment within the configured limits.

inputs.name: enrichWebsite
inputs.description: Visit business websites to extract emails, phones, contact forms, and social links. Used only in deep mode.

inputs.name: emailScanDepth
inputs.description: Number of internal pages to scan for emails (e.g. /contact).

inputs.name: maxWebsitesToEnrich
inputs.description: Maximum number of unique websites to visit in deep mode.

inputs.name: maxRunTimeSec
inputs.description: Gracefully stop the run when this runtime budget is reached.

inputs.name: emailMxCheck
inputs.description: If true, checks MX records for extracted email domains to improve email-quality confidence. Slower and adds DNS requests.

inputs.name: dedupeBy
inputs.description: Field to use for deduplication.

inputs.name: newOnlyOutput
inputs.description: If true, outputs only new items not seen in previous runs. If false, outputs unique items from this run and marks them with isNew.

inputs.name: webhookUrl
inputs.description: URL to POST results to. Stored encrypted when saved (may contain auth tokens).

inputs.name: batchSize
inputs.description: Number of items to batch before calling webhook.

inputs.name: resourceProfile
inputs.description: Preset for concurrency based on the memory you allocate when starting the run.

inputs.name: detailConcurrency
inputs.description: Place detail pages fetched in parallel. If not set, uses the value from Resource profile.

inputs.name: enrichmentConcurrency
inputs.description: Website pages fetched in parallel during enrichment. If not set, uses the value from Resource profile.

inputs.name: debug
inputs.description: Enable verbose logging (includes URLs and business details in logs; use only when needed).

inputs.name: proxyMode
inputs.description: Enable proxying. Google Maps uses Residential for browser compatibility and websites use Unblocker. Select Direct only for testing.

inputs.name: proxyCountryCode
inputs.description: Optional two-letter country code, for example DE or US. Leave empty to let Unblocker choose.

outputs.name: place_name
outputs.description: Business or place name when available.

outputs.name: address
outputs.description: Detected street address or location text when available.
